_how_to_use: Add one object per real buyer to the testimonials list. Use their exact words, and set permission_confirmed to true only after they have said yes in writing. Entries with false are never shown. Then set SHOW_TESTIMONIALS to true in main.js. The _example entry below is not in the list and never renders.

_example.name: First name and last initial
_example.detail: Short role line, e.g. Started in week 2, working out in a small flat
